def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\n", "\\n")


def render(name, dot_src):
    src = os.path.join(IMG, name + ".dot")
    out = os.path.join(IMG, name + ".png")
    with open(src, "w") as f:
        f.write(dot_src)
    subprocess.run(["dot", "-Tpng", "-Gdpi=160", src, "-o", out], check=True)
    return out


def node_block(nid, fill, fontcolor="white", penwidth=1, color="#222222"):
    label, _ = SUBSYSTEMS[nid]
    return (f'  {nid} [label="{nid}. {esc(label)}", fillcolor="{fill}", '
            f'fontcolor="{fontcolor}", color="{color}", penwidth={penwidth}];\n')

    s = ['digraph G {', '  rankdir=BT; bgcolor="white"; compound=true;',
         '  node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fontname="Helvetica", '
         'fontsize=11, width=1.5, height=0.7, margin="0.08,0.05"];',
         '  edge [color="#bbbbbb", arrowsize=0.6, penwidth=0.8];',
         '  graph [fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=13, ranksep=0.55, nodesep=0.3];']
    for layer in LAYER_ORDER:
        ids = [i for i, (_, l) in SUBSYSTEMS.items() if l == layer]
        s.append(f'  subgraph cluster_{layer} {{')
        s.append(f'    label="{LAYER_LABELS[layer]}"; style="rounded,filled"; '
                 f'fillcolor="#f4f4f6"; color="#dddddd"; fontcolor="#555555";')
        for i in ids:
            s.append(node_block(i, LAYER_COLOR[layer]))
        s.append('    {rank=same; ' + '; '.join(str(i) for i in ids) + ';}')
        s.append('  }')
    for a, b, _ in EDGES:
        s.append(f'  {a} -> {b};')
    s.append('}')
    return render("master", "\n".join(s))

def diagram_detail(center):

    ins = [(a, b, lbl) for (a, b, lbl) in EDGES if b == center]
    neighbors = set()

        neighbors.add(a); neighbors.add(b)
    neighbors.discard(center)
    s = ['digraph G {', '  rankdir=LR; bgcolor="white";',
         '  node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fontname="Helvetica", '
         'fontsize=11, width=1.5, height=0.6, margin="0.08,0.05"];',
         '  edge [fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=8, color="#999999", '
         'fontcolor="#555555", arrowsize=0.6];',
         '  graph [ranksep=1.6, nodesep=0.18];']
    clayer = SUBSYSTEMS[center][1]
    s.append(node_block(center, LAYER_COLOR[clayer], penwidth=3, color="#111111"))
    for n in sorted(neighbors):
        nlayer = SUBSYSTEMS[n][1]
        s.append(node_block(n, LAYER_COLOR[nlayer] + "bb", color="#cccccc"))
    for a, b, lbl in outs:
        s.append(f'  {a} -> {b} [label="{esc(lbl)}", color="#7a2f4a", penwidth=1.4];')
    for a, b, lbl in ins:
        s.append(f'  {a} -> {b} [label="{esc(lbl)}", color="#2f6b6b", penwidth=1.4, style=dashed];')
    s.append('}')
    return render(f"detail_{center}", "\n".join(s))

def add_text(slide, x, y, w, h, text, size, color=INK, bold=False,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font="Helvetica", anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    para = tf.paragraphs[0]
    para.alignment = align
    run = para.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font
    return tb


def add_band(slide, color, h=Inches(1.15)):
    band = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, 0, 0, SW, h)
    band.fill.solid()
    band.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    band.line.fill.background()
    band.shadow.inherit = False
    return band


def fit_image(slide, path, x, y, max_w, max_h):
    from PIL import Image as _I
    try:
        iw, ih = _I.open(path).size
    except Exception:
        pic = slide.shapes.add_picture(path, x, y, width=max_w)
        return pic
    ratio = min(max_w / iw, max_h / ih)
    w = int(iw * ratio); h = int(ih * ratio)
    px = x + int((max_w - w) / 2)
    py = y + int((max_h - h) / 2)
    return slide.shapes.add_picture(path, px, py, width=w, height=h)

PART 5 — DIVERGENT DESIGN DIRECTIONS  (bigger bets for the new ADW)
================================================================================
These are not fixes to today's ADW; they are alternative shapes worth weighing
for a model-agnostic rebuild. Opinionated, not prescriptive.

5.1 Provider-first core. Make ModelProvider (1.2) the FIRST thing built, with
    a fake/replay provider for tests, before any pipeline code. Today the
    model coupling leaked because the CLI was the substrate; invert that.

5.2 Reconsider the single-host constraint. The coordination kernel (subsystem
    9) is the most over-engineered part precisely because it emulates
    distributed coordination on one host with files + PIDs. If the rebuild can
    assume a real queue/DB (the D1 worker already exists), a job-queue model
    (claim by row-lock, lease + heartbeat in the DB) would replace spawnGate /
    processLiveness / remoteReconcile / takeoverHandler with one well-understood
    primitive — and lift the single-host limitation as a side effect. This is
    the single largest simplification available.

5.3 Treat state as a DB, not a tree of JSON files. agents/{adwId}/state.json +
    sidecar files + remoteReconcile-from-GitHub is a homegrown event store.
    The same D1/SQLite the cost module uses could hold workflow state, making
    resume/recovery a query instead of a filesystem reconstruction.

5.4 Prompts as versioned, provider-neutral templates (1.4) with a thin
    per-provider renderer. Decouples "what we ask the model" from "how Claude
    Code happens to deliver it," and makes prompt changes diffable without
    touching delivery code.

5.5 One verdict engine. Fold subsystem 8's three verdict sources (2.7) plus
    resolveVerdict/testVerdict into a single pure module the whole pipeline
    consumes — testability win and removes the JUnit/exit-code/proof
    reconciliation guesswork.

5.6 Decide whether BDD-as-contract survives. The bdd-rewrite PRDs admit the
    suite was "glorified linting" (file-existence asserts). The behavioral
    rewrite is real progress, but a from-scratch ADW should decide up front
    whether scenarios remain the plan/impl contract or whether TDD (subsystem
    8 + the implement-tdd skill) becomes primary and BDD becomes regression-
    only. Today both coexist (the two-reconciler problem in 2.3).
